description: Why: operators reload config via SIGHUP to add or revoke trusted peers without restarting the daemon. What: session.rs captures trusted_keys into a local Vec at session start (let trusted_keys = shared.trusted_keys.read().await.clone()). do_reload() updates the Arc<RwLock<Vec>> in ReloadableState but the cloned Vec held by each active session is never refreshed. A revoked key will still authenticate successfully on its existing session until that session disconnects. A newly added key will not authenticate on existing sessions.
title: Trusted keys snapshot at session start; SIGHUP reload not applied to running sessions
